narrative.coaching_note: Always clean your hands right after you leave the bedside area around bed rail A and before you touch anything outside it. You touched bed rail A with bare hand starting at 0.5 seconds, and that moved contamination to your hand. You then touched call button at 3.4 seconds and phone at 6.6 seconds, which carried it to those surfaces. You missed hand hygiene after the bedside contact at 5.8 seconds and again with gloved hand at 18.7 seconds, and your hands, bed rail A, call button and phone were still contaminated at the end. Next time clean your hands with alcohol rub before you put gloves on at 10.9 seconds and take gloves off before touching phone at 19.3 seconds.
narrative.audit_summary: Source was bed rail A (patient_zone_A). Bare hand contacted bed rail A at 0.5s, with onward transfer to call button at 3.4s and phone at 6.6s, and gloved hand contacted bed rail A at 11.1s. Two Moment 5 opportunities were missed (0/2 met; overall 0/2; Moments 1, 2 and 4 had 0 opportunities), at 5.8s (bare hand) and 18.7s (gloved hand). No hand hygiene events occurred. Glove practice included donning at 10.9s without prior effective hand hygiene and touching phone, a healthcare-area object, with gloved hand at 19.3s. At end, bare hand, gloved hand, bed rail A, call button and phone remained contaminated; no resident exposures occurred. Disinfect bed rail A, call button and phone using an EPA List H registered disinfectant (effective against MRSA).
narrative.top_fix: The highest-impact single change in this clip was hand hygiene after touching the bedside area at 5.8 seconds.
